items.title: Qualcomm Stocks Climb 4.18% After Tying CEO Award to $500 Share Price
items.summary: Qualcomm granted up to $65 million in performance stock to its top two executives, paying only at price milestones from $250 to $500.

items.title: Qualcomm (QCOM) Stock Is Up 6.9% Today: Chip Stocks Rally With Market
items.summary: On Friday, Nov. 27, the shares rose 6.9% as chip stocks rallied with the broader market, without company-specific news.

items.title: Qualcomm Is Betting Big on a $5 Billion Opportunity. Here’s What It Could Mean for the Stock
items.summary: Handsets are shrinking, the stock just whipsawed double digits, and Wall Street analysts mostly shrug. Yet one fast-growing business, limited by supply instead of demand, may be quietly rewriting Qualcomm's story. Can it outrun the risks hiding in its customer list?

items.title: Trump’s New Tariffs Hit Taiwan but Spare Its Chips. That’s Good News for TSMC and Apple
items.summary: Key TakeawaysWashington proposed tariffs of up to 15% on Taiwan, or up to 25% if talks fail. Taiwan’s notice exempts chips, smartphones, PCs and servers, the core of TSMC’s, Apple’s and Qualcomm’s businesses.

items.title: George Soros and 8 Other Big Funds Sold S&P Global Last Quarter, While 12 Bought. Who’s Right?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysOf the 460 big funds that have filed 13Fs for the third quarter, 12 bought S&P Global and 9 sold it, George Soros’ fund among the sellers. The buyers put far more money behind the stock: Evergreen Quality Fund’s add alone was bigger than all nine sales combined.
